dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: So it was her all along. I might have known.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Alice is the only one in all of Mondstadt that could've pulled this off... Well, her and that bard.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Those letters were actually invitations. I guess that makes us the guests to the party.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hah... Which means that in her heart, we're all a bunch of children.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I haven't been taken for a child in a long time. Hmph.
